reviews.t: I got more than I anticipated
reviews.x: I actually got 14 samples, one I don’t have the paper that came with it. But the scents are amazing. There are a few I didn’t like but that’s why I bought this, to see which one I wanted to spend my money on. The Flora by Gucci is the best!

I bought these to use in an advent calendar for my teen daughter. Received exactly what was pictured plus bonus perfumes!! Great quality, fast delivery, ideal way to try various scents before buying full size, and perfect for travel! I recommend this item from this seller!

Five of the main ones I was looking forward to receiving were not included in the package, even though they were listed.  The package also wasn't marked as "fragile" so it sat in my hot mailbox (was 112 degrees on the day it was received) for over 4 hours, and some of the vials had NO fragrance at all.  I will be more careful next time and order them in the Fall or Winter.

Bueno para empezar me mandaron todos diferentes más de hombre que de mujer y las muestras femeninas algunas vinieron vacías y otras repetidas o sea que las que yo quería como se veía en la imagen solo me llegaron como tres no entiendo nada

I love designer perfumes, but I'd never buy one without testing it first as even if the description sounds nice, I just need to know for myself how it smells! Perfume is one thing I'll never skimp on, a quality smell is important to me, and this assortment of samples was perfect for helping me find the fancy perfumes of my needs. It also had a nice presentation :) Overall I loved sampling all of these! Highly recommend if you're trying to find the perfect perfume

Every sample i smelled was the same and smelled like a old woman perfume and definitely not meaning a milf smell either. Eww I suggest buying perfume from a reputable site. I went to fragrance net .con and I got a gucci flora sampler and it had three different smells and the biggest two which were gucci flora gorgeous gardenia it is my new smell it smells so good. I paid 80 for them but definitely DO NOT BUY FAKE!!!!!!

I bought a couple of these samples from two different vendors. I will return to this vendor again and again…The packaging was impeccable AND a they added a personal thank you note ….such a nice touch. It’s nice when you open a thoughtfully packaged purchase these days. Very nice. The perfumes are in great shape and exactly what I had hoped for. I highly recommend this vendor

reviews.t: Great Gift for the discerning nose
reviews.x: I got these for my daughter who started wearing perfume.  It was a great place for her to start. Had a variety of perfumes (some very well known) from fruity and sweet, to more subtle. She has been able to pick and choose which ones she likes and those that she didn't like she 'gifted' to other family or friends.  The sizes were perhaps a bit smaller than I anticipated, but the point is to 'sample' them. Overall, I'd give this a 4 1/2 stars.  I thought this was a pretty good deal and it has defi

reviews.t: great gift for the teenager testing out before you buy full product
reviews.x: this was a hit as a gift. the only thing was i thought they were a bit bigger but she loved them regardless. its a great way for her to test the smell before spending way to much on something she would never use. fyi very potent smelling when opening bag first time.

reviews.t: Exceeded expectations and glad I found this to send as a gift!
reviews.x: Wanted to get fragrance sampler as a holiday gift and unfortunately the one I wanted was out of stock. But then I started looking on Amazon and found this one and I’m happy I did. It was A LOT less than one I was looking for and so far my daughter has raves about several of the samples. She has found one she said she is now obsessed with so this was perfect way to try several fragrances with little money commitment. Highly recommend and would order again.

I was looking forward to sampling a few scents featured in the picture. There was no disclaimer to assume it was a random selection of those brands. So be aware when you purchase this it will be a SURPRISE.
I can smell different each day. No commitment. The ones I dont like I give to a friend. Perfect for purses. They dont last a ton but thats ok, I sometimes get sick of it after a while
This is a must buy if you are trying to find the right scent! Great packaging, great seller, and great product. Highly recommend!
Great size for a purse or travel.  Many fragrances to choose from.  With these samples I can make a decision which one I would like in a larger size. Glad I found this item.

reviews.t: Fragrances received were not fragrances advertised.
reviews.x: When I contacted seller was told they sent what they had. Totally unacceptable. Scents received were outdated fragrances. False advertisement

reviews.t: Just what I was looking for
reviews.x: I get nose burnout when sampling at store and I get nervous with the sales person looming.  This was a perfect way to sample scents!
Maybe it’s just me but i didn’t really like any of the scents in here. you do get what you pay for tho lots of samples which is nice

reviews.t: Perfect set to find the perfect scent!
reviews.x: A wide variety of different designer scents. There was even a couple extra scents thrown in there as well. Highly recommend!

I bought this intending to give it as a gift, however I would be embarrassed to give this to someone. It looks like I walked around the perfume counter at a department store collecting samples. I expected A LOT more for the price. I could even get past how small the samples were if they were packaged presentable. Instead you’re given a plastic bag with tiny, tiny, tiny samples of perfume thrown in it.  Very disappointing.

reviews.t: For the amount of scents you get to try- totally worth it
reviews.x: This purchase was absolutely worth it. I received 14 samples in my package, all high name brands. The only downside to this is some of the samples were only half full but it is still PLENTY for a few wears to see if you like the product. This is a cost effective way to try quality perfumes without spending money on something you’re unsure of.

I bought these as stocking stuffers. I thought it would be a great idea to introduce others and myself to fragrances that we didn't already have in our collection. I actually purchased complete bottles of fragrances after trying some of these samples.

reviews.t: I am very unhappy about this item.  These are actually free samples  given out as testers
reviews.x: I need to return  this item because they are FREE samples which I can pick up at Notdstrom or Macys fur free.  It is a rip off and I really want my money back.  I’m very unhappy about this purchase.  The description was extremely misleading
Definitely has some fire scents in here that has me purchasing the big bottles !! 10 out of 10 highly recommended if you looking for new scents or perfumes to travel with.
I never leave bad reviews. But I didn’t get anything of what was shown in the picture and I also don’t like the smell of any of the scents. Very disappointed

I have just gotten into wanting to try perfume from B&BW 2 second spray. This was a good starter one. Had some popular to lesser known, cheaper to more expensive!! Wait like 10 minutes & smell yourself again with it on because it changes. I felt like it had decent variety, so if you KNOW you want *floral or musk or citrus or vanilla* ONLY/mostly, do not get this. It had 2 or 3 of each category.

claims.text: Many customers appreciate the sampler as a way to try a variety of scents before committing to a full-size bottle.
Several reviewers say the selection did not match what was advertised, with specific listed fragrances missing or substituted.
The sampler is frequently described as a great gift, especially for teens or daughters.
Positive reviewers praise the packaging, fast delivery, and helpful seller.
Some reviewers report quality problems such as empty vials, repeated samples, or scents that all smell the same.
